title: The Watcher's Prophecy
author: Seer Nimaeth of the Domes
pages: I have watched the place where the Dawn-Star used to rise for three hundred years, as my mother did before me. This year it did not shine at all. I have written down what the sky is saying.
When the Tall Ones walk in daylight, the binding thins. When the seeking eyes fly home, the doors are found. When stars fall three nights together, the chain is broken and the lamp is out.
Then comes the Waning: long nights, grey harvests, hungry roads. Then comes the Night that does not end, and the dead who are not remembered will not stay down.
The proud will cry: the beast is slain, the dawn returns! The dawn will not return. Only a new light, kindled where the old one fell and paid for by someone who loves the world, will end it.
I do not know who will pay. The stars do not say. The Fatalists say it is written. I say a warning is only a warning. Read this, and do not go to the Hollow with a sword.
